onboarding.title: Welcome to the map editor
onboarding.subtitle: Align your PDF trail map with the live base map, trace routes, and export precision GeoJSON.
onboarding.step1Desc: Use Add reference, then Ctrl+click the same landmark on the base map and on your PDF. Add at least three spread across the sheet.
onboarding.step2Desc: Turn on Trace trail, then Ctrl+click vertices along paths. Drag points to adjust. Save each segment when finished.
onboarding.step3Desc: Open Controls to import reference trails, cache offline map tiles, and manage control points and segments.
onboarding.step4Desc: Preview your GeoJSON before saving. Export a FeatureCollection when your routes are ready.

about.heading: About
about.body: Built with create-era-next — the modern successor to electron-react-boilerplate.
about.tipsIntro: A quick guide to getting the most out of the map editor and agent tools.

reference.title: Align with reference points
reference.body: Open a map project, add at least three reference points with Ctrl+click on the base map and the same spots on your PDF. Spread them across the sheet for better alignment.

trace.title: Trace trails on the map
trace.body: Use Trace trail mode to place vertices along paths. Drag points to fine-tune. Save each segment when finished — segments become exportable GeoJSON LineStrings.

export.title: Preview before you export
export.body: Use Preview GeoJSON in the workspace toolbar to inspect your FeatureCollection. Export when routes and metadata look right.

mcp.title: Connect an AI agent via MCP
mcp.body: Enable the local MCP server in Settings and paste the config into Cursor. Agents can place reference points, trace segments, and read map state while you review.

history.title: Review every edit
history.body: Open History in the sidebar for a global audit log, or Ctrl+Shift+H inside a map project. Filter, search, and expand entries to see what changed.

playground.title: Try the map playground
playground.body: Home is a lightweight sandbox — drop GeoJSON files, toggle layers, and explore trails without creating a full map project.

about.exploreIntro: Jump straight to the main areas of the app.
about.updatesHint: Check whether a newer build is available.
